seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x3, w x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks (colour-10 4x4) move together: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together, mirrored by which half each block is in.
Click inactive marker (9) arms: blocks -> players (1), marker -> active (11); clicking a player disarms; other clicks no-op.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker 4 cells; any move succeeds iff destination 4x4 is all floor colour 5 within rows 1-62.
HUD: colour-0 bars in row 0 (from right) and row 63 (from left), width (128a+150)//300, a = actions this level, continuity-gated memo.
Hypothesis (wall A3 no_change vs w) = the HUD bar wall_0 widening on some actions, not click position; level-reset trigger unconfirmed.
